from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup_6samples_triplicate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    master_mix_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    module = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    block = module.load_labware("opentrons_96_aluminumblock_generic_pcr_strip_200ul")
    
    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="master mix", description="SYBR green master mix with primers", display_color="#FF0000")
    sample_1 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 1", description="cDNA sample 1", display_color="#00FF00")
    sample_2 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 2", description="cDNA sample 2", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_3 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 3", description="cDNA sample 3", display_color="#FFFF00")
    sample_4 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 4", description="cDNA sample 4", display_color="#FF00FF")
    sample_5 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 5", description="cDNA sample 5", display_color="#00FFFF")
    sample_6 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 6", description="cDNA sample 6", display_color="#FFFFFF")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    master_mix_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1000)
    block["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_1, volume=100)
    block["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_2, volume=100)
    block["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_3, volume=100)
    block["A4"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_4, volume=100)
    block["A5"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_5, volume=100)
    block["A6"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_6, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Pick up tip
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    
    # Define destination wells
    dest_wells = [
        plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"],
        plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"],
        plate["A7"], plate["A8"], plate["A9"],
        plate["A10"], plate["A11"], plate["A12"],
        plate["B1"], plate["B2"], plate["B3"],
        plate["B4"], plate["B5"], plate["B6"]
    ]
    
    # Distribute master mix (8 ul) to all 18 destination wells in groups
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[0:8])
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[8:16])
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[16:18])
    
    # Map samples to source and destination wells
    samples = [
        (sample_1, block["A1"], dest_wells[0:3]),
        (sample_2, block["A2"], dest_wells[3:6]),
        (sample_3, block["A3"], dest_wells[6:9]),
        (sample_4, block["A4"], dest_wells[9:12]),
        (sample_5, block["A5"], dest_wells[12:15]),
        (sample_6, block["A6"], dest_wells[15:18]),
    ]
    
    # Add 2 ul of each sample to its 3 destination wells
    for sample, source, destinations in samples:
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, source)
        for dest in destinations:
            p20_multi.dispense(2, dest)
    
    # Drop tip
    p20_multi.drop_tip()

from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup_6samples_triplicate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    master_mix_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    module = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    block = module.load_labware("opentrons_96_aluminumblock_generic_pcr_strip_200ul")
    
    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="master mix", description="SYBR green master mix with primers", display_color="#FF0000")
    sample_1 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 1", description="cDNA sample 1", display_color="#00FF00")
    sample_2 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 2", description="cDNA sample 2", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_3 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 3", description="cDNA sample 3", display_color="#FFFF00")
    sample_4 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 4", description="cDNA sample 4", display_color="#FF00FF")
    sample_5 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 5", description="cDNA sample 5", display_color="#00FFFF")
    sample_6 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 6", description="cDNA sample 6", display_color="#FFFFFF")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    master_mix_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1000)
    block["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_1, volume=100)
    block["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_2, volume=100)
    block["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_3, volume=100)
    block["A4"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_4, volume=100)
    block["A5"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_5, volume=100)
    block["A6"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_6, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Pick up tip
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    
    # Define destination wells
    dest_wells = [
        plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"],
        plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"],
        plate["A7"], plate["A8"], plate["A9"],
        plate["A10"], plate["A11"], plate["A12"],
        plate["B1"], plate["B2"], plate["B3"],
        plate["B4"], plate["B5"], plate["B6"]
    ]
    
    # Distribute master mix (8 ul) to all 18 destination wells in groups
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[0:8])
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[8:16])
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[16:18])
    
    # Map samples to source and destination wells
    samples = [
        (sample_1, block["A1"], dest_wells[0:3]),
        (sample_2, block["A2"], dest_wells[3:6]),
        (sample_3, block["A3"], dest_wells[6:9]),
        (sample_4, block["A4"], dest_wells[9:12]),
        (sample_5, block["A5"], dest_wells[12:15]),
        (sample_6, block["A6"], dest_wells[15:18]),
    ]
    
    # Add 2 ul of each sample to its 3 destination wells
    for sample, source, destinations in samples:
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, source)
        for dest in destinations:
            p20_multi.dispense(2, dest)
    
    # Drop tip
    p20_multi.drop_tip()

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup_6samples_triplicate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    master_mix_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    module = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    block = module.load_labware("opentrons_96_aluminumblock_generic_pcr_strip_200ul")
    
    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="master mix", description="SYBR green master mix with primers", display_color="#FF0000")
    sample_1 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 1", description="cDNA sample 1", display_color="#00FF00")
    sample_2 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 2", description="cDNA sample 2", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_3 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 3", description="cDNA sample 3", display_color="#FFFF00")
    sample_4 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 4", description="cDNA sample 4", display_color="#FF00FF")
    sample_5 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 5", description="cDNA sample 5", display_color="#00FFFF")
    sample_6 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 6", description="cDNA sample 6", display_color="#FFFFFF")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    master_mix_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1000)
    block["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_1, volume=100)
    block["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_2, volume=100)
    block["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_3, volume=100)
    block["A4"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_4, volume=100)
    block["A5"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_5, volume=100)
    block["A6"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_6, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Define destination wells
    dest_wells = [
        plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"],
        plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"],
        plate["A7"], plate["A8"], plate["A9"],
        plate["A10"], plate["A11"], plate["A12"],
        plate["B1"], plate["B2"], plate["B3"],
        plate["B4"], plate["B5"], plate["B6"]
    ]
    
    # Distribute master mix to A1-A8 (8 wells)
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[0:8])
    
    # Distribute master mix to B1-B6 (6 wells)
    p20_multi.distribute(8, master_mix_rack["A1"], dest_wells[12:18])
    
    # Fill A9-A12 (4 wells) individually
    for i in range(8, 12):
        p20_multi.aspirate(8, master_mix_rack["A1"])
        p20_multi.dispense(8, plate[f"A{i+1}"])
    
    # Pick up a tip for sample addition
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    
    # Map samples to source and destination wells
    samples = [
        (sample_1, block["A1"], dest_wells[0:3]),
        (sample_2, block["A2"], dest_wells[3:6]),
        (sample_3, block["A3"], dest_wells[6:9]),
        (sample_4, block["A4"], dest_wells[9:12]),
        (sample_5, block["A5"], dest_wells[12:15]),
        (sample_6, block["A6"], dest_wells[15:18]),
    ]
    
    # Add 2 ul of each sample to its 3 destination wells
    for sample, source, destinations in samples:
        p20_multi.aspirate(2, source)
        for dest in destinations:
            p20_multi.dispense(2, dest)
    
    # Drop tip
    p20_multi.drop_tip()"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    master_mix_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    # Load temperature module and block
    temp_module = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    block = temp_module.load_labware("opentrons_96_aluminumblock_generic_pcr_strip_200ul")
    # Set temperature
    temp_module.set_temperature(4)
    
    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="master mix", description="SYBR green master mix with primers", display_color="#FF0000")
    sample_1 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 1", description="cDNA sample 1", display_color="#00FF00")
    sample_2 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 2", description="cDNA sample 2", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_3 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 3", description="cDNA sample 3", display_color="#FFFF00")
    sample_4 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 4", description="cDNA sample 4", display_color="#FF00FF")
    sample_5 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 5", description="cDNA sample 5", display_color="#00FFFF")
    sample_6 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 6", description="cDNA sample 6", display_color="#FFFFFF")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    master_mix_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1000)
    block["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_1, volume=100)
    block["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_2, volume=100)
    block["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_3, volume=100)
    block["A4"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_4, volume=100)
    block["A5"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_5, volume=100)
    block["A6"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_6, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Define destination wells (18 wells total)
    dest_wells = [
        plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"], plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"],
        plate["A7"], plate["A8"], plate["A9"], plate["A10"], plate["A11"], plate["A12"],

    ]
    
    # Fill each destination well with 8 ul of master mix

    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for well in dest_wells:
        p20_multi.aspirate(8, master_mix_rack["A1"])
        p20_multi.dispense(8, well)
    p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 2 ul of each sample to its 3 destination wells
    sample_sources = [
        block["A1"],  # sample 1
        block["A2"],  # sample 2
        block["A3"],  # sample 3
        block["A4"],  # sample 4
        block["A5"],  # sample 5

            # Mix after adding sample

        p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Deactivate temperature module
    temp_module.deactivate()

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup_6samples_triplicate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    master_mix_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    temp_module = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    block = temp_module.load_labware("opentrons_96_aluminumblock_generic_pcr_strip_200ul")
    temp_module.set_temperature(4)  # keep samples cold
    
    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="master mix", description="SYBR green master mix with primers", display_color="#FF0000")
    sample_1 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 1", description="cDNA sample 1", display_color="#00FF00")
    sample_2 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 2", description="cDNA sample 2", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_3 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 3", description="cDNA sample 3", display_color="#FFFF00")
    sample_4 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 4", description="cDNA sample 4", display_color="#FF00FF")
    sample_5 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 5", description="cDNA sample 5", display_color="#00FFFF")
    sample_6 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 6", description="cDNA sample 6", display_color="#FFFFFF")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    master_mix_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1000)
    block["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_1, volume=100)
    block["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_2, volume=100)
    block["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_3, volume=100)
    block["A4"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_4, volume=100)
    block["A5"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_5, volume=100)
    block["A6"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_6, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Define destination wells (18 unique wells)
    dest_wells = [
        plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"],  # sample 1
        plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"],  # sample 2
        plate["B1"], plate["B2"], plate["B3"],  # sample 3
        plate["B4"], plate["B5"], plate["B6"],  # sample 4
        plate["C1"], plate["C2"], plate["C3"],  # sample 5
        plate["C4"], plate["C5"], plate["C6"]   # sample 6
    ]
    
    # Fill each destination well with 8 ul of master mix (first tip)
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for well in dest_wells:
        p20_multi.aspirate(8, master_mix_rack["A1"])
        p20_multi.dispense(8, well)
    p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 2 ul of each sample to its 3 destination wells
    sample_sources = [
        block["A1"],  # sample 1
        block["A2"],  # sample 2
        block["A3"],  # sample 3
        block["A4"],  # sample 4
        block["A5"],  # sample 5
        block["A6"],  # sample 6
    ]
    
    for i, source in enumerate(sample_sources):
        p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
        dest_group = dest_wells[i*3 : i*3+3]
        for dest in dest_group:
            p20_multi.aspirate(2, source)
            p20_multi.dispense(2, dest)
            # Mix after adding sample
            p20_multi.mix(5, 8, dest)
        p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Deactivate temperature module
    temp_module.deactivate()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "qPCR_setup_6samples_triplicate", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tip_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    master_mix_rack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_snapcap", 2)
    plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 3)
    temp_module = protocol.load_module("temperature module gen2", 4)
    block = temp_module.load_labware("opentrons_96_aluminumblock_generic_pcr_strip_200ul")
    temp_module.set_temperature(4)  # keep samples cold
    
    # Define liquids
    master_mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="master mix", description="SYBR green master mix with primers", display_color="#FF0000")
    sample_1 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 1", description="cDNA sample 1", display_color="#00FF00")
    sample_2 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 2", description="cDNA sample 2", display_color="#0000FF")
    sample_3 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 3", description="cDNA sample 3", display_color="#FFFF00")
    sample_4 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 4", description="cDNA sample 4", display_color="#FF00FF")
    sample_5 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 5", description="cDNA sample 5", display_color="#00FFFF")
    sample_6 = protocol.define_liquid(name="sample 6", description="cDNA sample 6", display_color="#FFFFFF")
    
    # Load liquids into source wells
    master_mix_rack["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=master_mix, volume=1000)
    block["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_1, volume=100)
    block["A2"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_2, volume=100)
    block["A3"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_3, volume=100)
    block["A4"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_4, volume=100)
    block["A5"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_5, volume=100)
    block["A6"].load_liquid(liquid=sample_6, volume=100)
    
    # Load pipette
    p20_multi = protocol.load_instrument("p20_multi_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack])
    
    # Define destination wells (18 unique wells)
    dest_wells = [
        plate["A1"], plate["A2"], plate["A3"],  # sample 1
        plate["A4"], plate["A5"], plate["A6"],  # sample 2
        plate["B1"], plate["B2"], plate["B3"],  # sample 3
        plate["B4"], plate["B5"], plate["B6"],  # sample 4
        plate["C1"], plate["C2"], plate["C3"],  # sample 5
        plate["C4"], plate["C5"], plate["C6"]   # sample 6
    ]
    
    # Fill each destination well with 8 ul of master mix (first tip)
    p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
    for well in dest_wells:
        p20_multi.aspirate(8, master_mix_rack["A1"])
        p20_multi.dispense(8, well)
    p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Add 2 ul of each sample to its 3 destination wells
    sample_sources = [
        block["A1"],  # sample 1
        block["A2"],  # sample 2
        block["A3"],  # sample 3
        block["A4"],  # sample 4
        block["A5"],  # sample 5
        block["A6"],  # sample 6
    ]
    
    for i, source in enumerate(sample_sources):
        p20_multi.pick_up_tip()
        dest_group = dest_wells[i*3 : i*3+3]
        for dest in dest_group:
            p20_multi.aspirate(2, source)
            p20_multi.dispense(2, dest)
            # Mix after adding sample
            p20_multi.mix(5, 8, dest)
        p20_multi.drop_tip()
    
    # Deactivate temperature module
    temp_module.deactivate()"}

protocol.py: 2 biology problems (1 error, 1 warning).

1. ERROR CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: 4 stocks
   line 48:  p20_multi.aspirate(8, master_mix_rack["A1"])
   At line 48 the tip went into master mix (tube A1 in slot 2), tube B1 in slot 2, tube C1
   in slot 2 and tube D1 in slot 2 while it still carried master mix (tube A1 in slot 2),
   the liquid from tube B1 in slot 2, the liquid from tube C1 in slot 2 and the liquid from
   tube D1 in slot 2 from an earlier step (this line did it twice). A tip that has touched
   one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so these stocks now hold
   material that does not belong there. Liquid drawn from them then took the unwanted
   material along into 81 other wells: wells B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, C1, C2, C3 and 30 more in
   slot 3; wells A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2, B3, B4 and 35 more in slot 4.
   Affected: tubes A1, B1, C1 and D1 in slot 2.
   Also reached 81 other wells: wells B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, C1, C2, C3 and 30 more in slot 3;
   wells A3, A4, A5, A6, B1, B2, B3, B4 and 35 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 48 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.

           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
